synthesis_packets.summary: The fork: is a relation a first-class record or a field on the record that holds it. Decided 2026-09-03 by res_relations_are_fields_or_action_records: a relation is a field on the record that makes the claim or the record of the action that asserted it, there is no canonical edge, and reverse lookups are derived. The record-owned proposal won; the other two were grafted.

consensus.statement: The edges shard carries no relation metadata today: label is empty on all 612 rows and no row has an author or a retirement field.
The citation duality has drifted in the live scope (79 embedded citations against 76 references edges) and must collapse to one form.
Every relation lives on the line of the record that makes the claim, or on the record of the action that asserted it; the edges shard is retired. Decided by the human on 2026-09-03.

contested_claims.statement: Every non-containment connection is a typed edge record with metadata, status, and provenance.
The storage shape stays; a record-kind registry removes the hand-maintained family lists.

minority_objections.objection: The repository already tried a relation-as-record family: service_bindings, created in migration 009 and dropped in 016 and 017.
A record of an action must keep its identity, actor, and lifecycle; the decision grafts this.

suggested_artifacts.summary: Every non-containment connection is an edge record.
A reference lives on the record that asserts it.
Keep the storage; build a record-kind registry.
